title: Tahini Sauce
description:
This tahini is perfect for:
falafel, roasted vegetables, shawarma, grilled meats, or as a dip with warm bread.

ingredients.title: Ingredients (Makes ~1 cup / 240 ml)
items: ½ cup (120 g) tahini paste (pure, unsweetened, well-stirred)
¼ cup (60 ml) fresh lemon juice (about 1–2 lemons)
¼ cup (60 ml) cold water (adjust for consistency)
1–2 garlic cloves, finely grated or minced
½ tsp fine salt (adjust to taste)
1–2 tsp extra-virgin olive oil (optional, for richness)
Pinch of ground cumin (optional, for depth)
Pinch of smoked paprika or Aleppo pepper (optional garnish)

instruction.title: Instructions
steps:
1. Prepare Tahini Base:
• Stir the tahini paste in its jar until smooth and uniform.
• Transfer to a mixing bowl.

2. Add Lemon & Garlic:
• Mix in the fresh lemon juice and minced garlic. At this stage, the mixture may thicken—this is normal.

3. Incorporate Water Slowly:
• Add cold water gradually, 1–2 tbsp at a time, whisking continuously until you reach a smooth, pourable consistency.
• Tip: Professional chefs aim for a sauce that coats the back of a spoon but isn’t runny.

4. Season & Adjust:
• Add salt, optional cumin, and taste.
• Adjust lemon or salt to balance tang and richness.

5. Finish with Olive Oil:
• Whisk in 1–2 tsp extra-virgin olive oil for a silky finish.
• For presentation, drizzle a little olive oil on top, sprinkle paprika or chopped parsley.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: falafel, roasted vegetables, shawarma, grilled meats, or as a dip with warm bread

chefTips: Fresh Ingredients: Use freshly squeezed lemon juice and high-quality tahini (stone-ground if possible).
Texture Control: Cold water helps emulsify; warm water can thin it too much.
Flavor Depth: Let the sauce rest 10–15 minutes before serving; flavors meld beautifully.
Serving Style: Serve in a shallow bowl with a swirl, drizzle of olive oil, and sprinkle of paprika or pine nuts for visual appeal.
